Number of Bolts n (Single Vertical Row,: Notes (AISC Manual Part 7 - Instantaneous Center of Rotation Method, Eq. 7-1):
1. Available shear strength of eccentric bolt group: phi*R_n = C * phi*r_v (LRFD) or R_n/Omega = C * (r_v/Omega) (ASD), where r_v = F_nv * A_b * n_s.
